title: Home
band.offline: You are offline. Showing what was read at {{time}}.
band.stale: These computers could not be refreshed. Showing the last list that loaded.
band.partial_one: Only {{count}} computer could be read. The list may be incomplete.
band.partial_other: Only {{count}} computers could be read. The list may be incomplete.
failed.title: Could not load your computers
failed.body: Nothing on this page can be shown until the list loads. Nothing was changed.
setupFailed.title: Could not check your account's setup
setupFailed.body: Home could not read whether your first computer is being set up. Nothing was changed.
pick.title: Pick a computer
pick.body: Choose the computer this dashboard should show.
setup.provisioning.title: Setting up your first computer
setup.provisioning.body: This usually takes a minute or two. This page checks again on its own.
setup.stalled.title: Setup is taking longer than expected
setup.stalled.body: Your computer has not come up after about 3 minutes. We stopped checking on our own. Retry asks for a fresh setup.
setup.redeem.trouble: The code could not be checked right now. Try again in a moment.
setup.blocked.support: Setup is stopped and needs help from support. Trying again will not change this. Write to us from the Support page.
setup.blocked.code: That code cannot be used for this account right now. Check the code, or ask whoever gave it to you for another.
setup.dismiss.title: Stop tracking this?
setup.dismiss.body: The earlier request may still have gone through. If you stop tracking this and try again, setup could run twice. Check first if you can.
setup.elsewhere: This was started on the Computers page and may have gone through. Check or stop tracking it there.
setup.retryWait: Please wait a moment before trying again.
setup.invite.title: Enter your invite code
setup.invite.body: Your account needs an invite code before it can get its first computer.
setup.inviteFailed.title: That code did not work
setup.inviteFailed.body: Check the code and try again. Codes can be used once.
setup.capacity.title: No room right now
setup.capacity.body: All servers are full at the moment. Check again in a little while.
setup.mailbox.title: This mailbox already has a computer
setup.mailbox.body: Only one free computer is given per mailbox. You can rent a server for more computers.
setup.expired.title: Your server has expired
setup.expired.body: Its computers are no longer reachable. You can rent another server.
setup.reinstalled.title: Your server was reinstalled
setup.reinstalled.body: The computers on it are gone. Delete them in Projects, then create a new computer.
shared.empty: Nothing is shared with you in this realm yet.
shared.emptyAll: Nothing is shared with you yet.
shared.emptyBody: Computers show here once the account's owner shares them with this access.
customize.title: Customize Home
customize.body: Switch a card off to hide it, and put the cards in your order. Saved in this browser.
customize.body.term: Pick the cards and their order. Kept until you close the Hub.
customize.none: No cards to arrange yet. Pages add their cards here as they become available.
empty.title: {{realm}} has no computers yet
empty.body: Each realm has its own computers. Get one for this realm, or show all your realms.
empty.bodyAll: A computer runs your programs, files and Bots. Get one to start.
ask.label: Ask {{name}} to do something
ask.labelNoName: Ask your computer to do something
ask.chip.online: Keep my app running after restarts
ask.open: Agent is open beside this page.
ask.startNotSent: Not sent. Your text is still here; ask again when you're ready.
ask.startUnknown: This may have gone through. Check the Agent panel before you ask again.
intro.lead: Your own computers in the cloud, each with an AI agent. Reach them from anywhere.
intro.tourReason: The tour is an animated page that plays on the web Hub.
intro.title: How Hoody fits together
intro.setupTitle: While you wait: how Hoody fits together
intro.realms.body: Separate spaces for work, a client or a project. The menu at the top picks one.
intro.computers.body: Real Linux machines that you own, each with its own address.
intro.on.body: Programs at their own link, a terminal, scripts, schedules and an AI agent that works there.
intro.bots.body: Assistants that work on your computers, reached by link, {{telegram}}, {{slack}}, {{discord}} or the API. They can ask you before risky steps.

steps.newToHoody: New to Hoody? See how it fits together

needs.held.scriptAny: Saving script {{path}} was not confirmed. Check whether it was saved.
needs.held.page: A change made on {{page}} for {{computer}} was not confirmed. Check whether it went through.
needs.held.pageAny: A change made on {{page}} was not confirmed. Check whether it went through.
needs.held.look: A change made on {{page}} for {{computer}} was not confirmed. Look at the script there to see whether it went through.
needs.held.lookAny: A change made on {{page}} was not confirmed. Look at the script there to see whether it went through.
needs.held.any: A change was not confirmed. Check whether it went through.
needs.held.unknown: A change was not confirmed, and the page that made it is not known.
needs.changes.body_one: The page where you made it shows when it is done.
needs.changes.body_other: The pages where you made them show when they are done.
